name: 制作人入口流程
description: L0 制作人统一入口，把模糊需求转化为可执行的 TaskPack
author: Pipeline-Sys

target_role.description: 目标执行角色（可选，不填则自动判断）

task_pack_path.description: 已有 TaskPack 路径（如提供则跳过生成）

project_root.description: 项目根目录（WSL 路径格式）

auto_execute.description: 是否自动执行生成的 TaskPack

nodes.name: 接收需求
nodes.expression: ({ request_id: inputs.request_id, title: inputs.title, description: inputs.description, requester: inputs.requester, priority: inputs.priority, received_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: AI分析需求
nodes.description: 调用 cursor-agent 分析需求，判断任务类型、角色和复杂度

nodes.name: 解析分析结果
nodes.expression: (() => { try { const stdout = nodes.analyze_request && nodes.analyze_request.output ? nodes.analyze_request.output.stdout : ''; if (!stdout) throw new Error('No output'); const result = JSON.parse(stdout); return { role: result.role || 'L3_engineer', task_type: result.task_type || 'code', complexity: result.complexity || 'normal', summary: result.summary || '', deliverables: result.deliverables || [] }; } catch(e) { return { role: 'L3_engineer', task_type: 'code', complexity: 'normal', summary: '', deliverables: [] }; } })()

nodes.name: 降级分析（无AI）
nodes.description: cursor-agent 失败时使用关键词匹配
nodes.expression: (() => { const desc = inputs.description.toLowerCase(); let role = inputs.target_role || 'L3_engineer'; let task_type = 'code'; if (desc.includes('文案') || desc.includes('对白') || desc.includes('剧情')) { role = 'L3_writer'; task_type = 'doc'; } else if (desc.includes('测试') || desc.includes('QA')) { role = 'L3_tester'; } else if (desc.includes('UI') || desc.includes('界面')) { role = 'L3_ui_engineer'; } return { role, task_type, complexity: inputs.priority === 'critical' ? 'complex' : 'normal', summary: '', deliverables: [] }; })()

nodes.name: 准备 TaskPack 内容
nodes.description: 使用分析结果生成 TaskPack 内容
nodes.expression:
(() => { const analysis = nodes.parse_analysis ? nodes.parse_analysis.output : (nodes.fallback_analyze ? nodes.fallback_analyze.output : { role: 'L3_engineer', task_type: 'code', complexity: 'normal', deliverables: [] }); const taskId = 'T-' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').slice(0,15) + '_' + inputs.request_id.slice(0,8); const deliverables = analysis.deliverables && analysis.deliverables.length > 0 ? analysis.deliverables.map(d => '- ' + d).join('
') : '- ./ (允许修改项目内任意文件)'; const content = '---
task_id: ' + taskId + '
title: "' + inputs.title + '"
task_type: ' + analysis.task_type + '
complexity: ' + analysis.complexity + '
model_override: auto
execution_runtime: wsl
requires_mcp: false
source: pm-intake
request_id: ' + inputs.request_id + '
---

# TASK-PACK: ' + taskId + '

## 1. Outcome
' + inputs.description + '

## 2. Allowed Inputs
- dir: ./

## 3. Deliverables
' + deliverables + '

## 4. Constraints
- 不得修改冻结目录 (design/ai-native/00_charter/, design/ai-native/01_bibles/)

## 5. Acceptance Checklist
- [ ] 交付物落盘
- [ ] 代码通过 lint 检查
- [ ] 发送完成通知
'; const taskPackPath = 'design/ai-native/03_taskpacks/' + taskId + '_task.md'; return { task_id: taskId, task_pack_path: taskPackPath, content: content, role: analysis.role, task_type: analysis.task_type, complexity: analysis.complexity }; })()

nodes.name: 写入 TaskPack 文件
nodes.description: 将生成的 TaskPack 写入文件系统

nodes.name: 确定执行器
nodes.description: 根据 AI 分析的角色选择执行流程
nodes.expression: (() => { const taskpackOutput = nodes.prepare_taskpack ? nodes.prepare_taskpack.output : {}; const role = taskpackOutput.role || 'L3_engineer'; const taskType = taskpackOutput.task_type || 'code'; let flowId = 'l3-execute'; if (role === 'L3_writer') flowId = 'l3-writer'; else if (role === 'L3_tester') flowId = 'l3-tester'; else if (role === 'L3_ui_engineer') flowId = 'l3-ui-engineer'; else if (role === 'L3_level_designer') flowId = 'l3-level-designer'; else if (role === 'L3_scripter') flowId = 'l3-scripter'; return { flow_id: flowId, role, task_type: taskType, task_pack_path: taskpackOutput.task_pack_path, task_id: taskpackOutput.task_id }; })()

nodes.name: 分发到执行器
nodes.description: 调用对应的角色流程执行任务
